_comment: OUR list, not the EBA's: candidate files linked from a single-rulebook leaf that the EBA has taken down for good. A leaf lists its riktlinje beside consultation responses, annexes and compliance tables; when one of those files 404s, guidance/eba_download deliberately does NOT memoize the leaf (settled_leaves), because a riktlinje whose PDF was served badly once must not drop out of the corpus. That retry is unbounded, so a permanently-removed file is re-fetched on every run at the EBA's Crawl-delay of 10 s and keeps its leaf in the walk forever. A url listed here is adjudicated gone: it is not fetched, and it does not hold its leaf open. The six below are the ones the walk met on 2026-08-26; all sit under the /documents/10180/ path of the Liferay CMS the EBA has retired, and they are a CEBS-era guideline (the committee dissolved in 2011), a draft RTS, two reports, a consultation feedback document and one bank's consultation response. eba_sync prints each 404'd candidate url under 'eba: dead candidate'; add one only after a run has named it. Removing an entry makes the next run try it again.
